_comment: Every entry in TwitchGenField._update_name's rename table. These are wire names that are illegal or reserved as GDScript identifiers, so the generated property is renamed while the JSON key must stay as-is. The API generator keeps _original_name for the wire side; the EventSub generator does not, which is what test_generator_parity.gd pins.

static.description: Renamed to static_format — 'static' is a GDScript keyword.

1.description: Renamed to _1 — identifiers cannot start with a digit.

source-only.description: Renamed to source_only — hyphens are illegal in identifiers.
